maddeler.e:
ابتلين (form VIII)
# اِبْتَلَيْنَ (ibtalayna) /ib.ta.laj.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِبْتَلَى (ibtalā)
# اُبْتُلِينَ (ubtulīna) /ub.tu.liː.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِبْتَلَى (ibtalā)
# اِبْتَلِينَ (ibtalīna) /ib.ta.liː.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِبْتَلَى (ibtalā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
